title: Singing from childhood: Sunday School choir, an orphan raised by her grandmother
summary: She sang around the house and in church choirs as a child, was orphaned young and raised by her grandmother and uncle, and had no training.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
